ideas.title: Your Eyes Hurt Because You Forgot They're Muscles
ideas.summary: Swollen, burning eyes after a day of screens? Huberman explains why your eye muscles are locked in a sustained contraction and exactly how to fix it with panoramic vision, exercises, and outdoor light.

ideas.title: Building the 6AM Habit: A 30-Day Survival Guide
ideas.summary: Knowing you should wake at 6 AM is easy. Actually doing it is war. Here's a science-backed 30-day protocol using Huberman, Atomic Habits, and Tiny Habits to make it stick.

ideas.title: The 6AM Wake-Up Protocol: Why Huberman Swears By It
ideas.summary: A 10:30 PM to 6:00 AM sleep schedule closely mirrors Andrew Huberman's own routine  - and science backs it up for optimal energy, focus, and longevity.
